title: The Plan That Froze the Window: A Long Computation, the Event Loop It Stopped, and One That Can Be Cancelled
fallback: This lesson is about keeping an event loop running while something long is done, so it needs Qt. Lesson 07-13 is about getting an answer back from work done elsewhere, and lesson 07-14 about asking that work to stop, in plain C++. Without Qt, do those and come back when Qt is installed.

artifact.note: a runner that does a long computation on another thread and reports its progress, its result or its cancellation on the thread that asked
